mentions.name: Next-gen self-hosted media server
mentions.description: A next-generation self-hosted media server software being built with Rust and Svelte, aiming to offer something much better than current media server solutions. It is an early-stage passion project idea still being explored.
mentions.problem: The author feels current media server solutions are not good enough and something much better can be made.
mentions.source_excerpt: Playing with an idea of a next-gen self-hosted media server software, with rust, svelte and all the goodies.
